retainedMechanisms: Header condensation after 24px, automatic hiding after 160px with 14px downward / 8px upward travel thresholds, and a temporary top-edge preview with 32px enter / 132px leave hysteresis. Keyboard focus, menu state and reduced-motion preference compose the final visibility.

Explicit EN / Chinese selection with a sliding language thumb; clicking the selected language does not request a language change. Existing in-page language rebuilding replaces upstream locale-route navigation, and native buttons expose their selected state through aria-pressed.

The upstream route exit lifts by -2.5rem, scales to 0.985 and fades over 260ms. The new page rises from 3.5rem and reveals from inset(100vh 0 0 0) over 600ms after 40ms, retaining the source cubic-bezier curves through installed GSAP CustomEase.

A repeatable IntersectionObserver visibility gate pauses the marquee offscreen. The preview's pre-existing velocity, skew, looping and 0.15 hover-speed formula are retained; the stationary parent is observed rather than the translated track. Unknown/offscreen updates do not read layout or write style, and leaving resets hover speed.
localLifecycleRepairs: React / Motion / React ViewTransition integration is adapted to existing native DOM and installed GSAP; no second application or animation runtime is installed. The theme's circular ViewTransition remains independent. This is a presentation adaptation, not an unmodified upstream drop-in.

Latest-request ownership, explicit cancellation resolution, protection against late animation cleanup, route epochs and reader-reveal scheduling are local integration repairs. They are not attributed as upstream source code or additional upstream business features.

src/reader-reveal.ts and src/main.ts treat a prepared, not-yet-revealed article as active ownership. A newer route cancels its queued first-paint reveal, releases inert and scroll state, and prevents a stale article from taking focus. Direct article startup retains the scroll lock until the reader is ready.

src/showcase.ts transfers focus from a replaced side-card button to its new front link and recomputes the focus pause gate. Refreshes preserve usable local focus while suspended/inert sections do not take focus from external controls or overlays.

Dynamic reduced motion cancels and clears actual page-body entrance tweens even after the outer route transition has completed. Existing global visibility/focus/overlay gates remain responsible for pausing the marquee; its observer caches only viewport eligibility. Marquee.setActive remeasures once when the shared main gate resumes, including clients without IntersectionObserver. Zero-width measurements of a hidden homepage no longer replace a valid cycle with 1px; steady update frames do not poll layout. This width/resume repair is local integration work, not an upstream motion change.

Controllers remove their listeners and observers on disposal; late IO, queued reveal and canceled animation callbacks cannot resume owned work. No new statistics, accounts, production writes or media assets are introduced.

verification.method: Read original Git object bytes at the pinned commit without a populated worktree. For each path record byte length and SHA-256, independently compute SHA1(blob + byteLength + NUL + originalBytes), and match git rev-parse. These hashes identify upstream bytes, not adapted local files.
